name: Easy Pecan Peach Cobbler with Caramel Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Place butter in a small saucepan and melt over medium-low heat. Add vanilla, stir to combine, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup butter, unsalted
½ tsp vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop pecans. Place in a medium bowl along with milk, baking mix, cinnamon, and nutmeg. Stir to combine the batter.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup pecan halves
1 cup whole milk
1 cup pancake & baking mix, original
¼ tsp cinnamon, ground
¼ tsp nutmeg, ground

instructions.primary_message: Add butter mixture to the bowl with the batter and stir once more to combine. Pour batter into an 8-inch square baking dish and spread out in an even layer.
Drain peaches. Place in a clean medium bowl along with caramel sauce. Stir to combine, then arrange the peaches and sauce over the top of the batter (do not mix).
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (425 g) can sliced peaches in juice
½ cup caramel sauce

instructions.primary_message: Place cobbler in the preheated oven and bake until golden and bubbling, 50-55 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly, 15 minutes.
To serve, divide cobbler between bowls and drizzle with additional caramel sauce. Enjoy!
